prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph as an editable software stack where browsing and authoring are two modes of the same Workspace object, never separate tools.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop app, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: A black-and-white application stack with a fixed top menu, slim stack-history rail at left, a large active Workspace card across the center, and a live browser card attached on the right as part of the same stack. Files, agent conversation, preview, changes, and skills appear as linked card layers with direct visible buttons. The active card exposes editing controls in place; back follows exact Workspace history.
Content: Sylph Workspace `Checkout restoration`, repository `folkhero-web`, active agent `Polish the onboarding flow`; browser preview shows a clean SaaS onboarding screen; file `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`; agent status `Testing the corrected mobile flow`; controls `Browse`, `Edit`, `Files`, `Changes`, `Skills`, `Preview`, `Take control`; status `Browser checks 4/4` and `Agent controlling browser`.
Style/medium: Fully committed HyperCard shoebox-stack grammar translated to a modern engineering tool: one-bit black on white, crisp stipple-dither grays, painted controls, fixed card rectangles, direct manipulation, subtle hand-drawn line variation. Use a compact pixel display face for menus and a highly legible system sans for dense code and agent content.
Composition/framing: The running product remains prominent inside the right card; the stack topology stays obvious. One focused card, linked layers, no bento dashboard.
Lighting/mood: Crisp, witty, fast, authorable.
Color palette: black #050505, white #FFFFFF, stipple gray #BEBEBE only; no accent color.
Materials/textures: one-bit ink, stipple fields, paper-white screen, painted black controls.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Checkout restoration`, `folkhero-web`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `Browse`, `Edit`, `Files`, `Changes`, `Skills`, `Preview`, `Take control`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Agent controlling browser`.
Constraints: Must read as an agentic cloud IDE with a first-class browser preview and in-place file/diff review. Dense but clear; controls look operable; no fake business claims.
Avoid: Macintosh device mockup, nostalgic desktop wallpaper, grayscale generic dashboard, rounded modern cards, gradients, neon, glassmorphism, marketing hero, illegible pixel text, decorative retro icons with no function.
